test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct regarding the rabi crops?

options.text: Southern and southeastern states are important for the production of wheat and other rabi crops.
These crops are harvested in summer from April to June.
Some of the important rabi crops are wheat, barley, peas, gram and mustard.
Rabi crops are sown in winter from October to December.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Southern and southeastern states are important for the production of wheat and other rabi crops.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, and Madhya Pradesh, **are major contributors to the production of **wheat, barley, and other rabi crops**. ***Hence Option 1 is incorrect.***
